editorial.blurb: A legendary Chicago hot dog stand where charred dogs and sass go hand-in-hand, best experienced late at night with a sense of humor and no ketchup.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the charred Chicago dog with hot peppers and absolutely do not skip the fries—arrive after midnight when the sassy banter from staff really makes the experience iconic, and the kitchen stays open until 4-5 a.m.
